User: I'm cleaning up how our services call external APIs.
Assistant: Okay. Do you have any standing preferences for the code?
User: I prefer retrying failed requests with exponential backoff. Also, always write docstrings in Google style.
Assistant: Got it. Exponential backoff on retries, Google-style docstrings.
User: Thanks. That's all for now.

User: Next up is Project Vega, a billing sync service for the finance team.
Assistant: Sounds good. Any constraints on how it calls other services?
User: For Project Vega, when the timeout is over 30 seconds, fail fast with no retries because the upstream gateway already retries internally.
Assistant: Understood. For Project Vega, long-timeout calls fail fast.
User: Great. Let's get going next time.
